findings.description: Within roughly one second after rising from the customer-side stool (01:51), the waitress lunges rightward and is then walking behind the counter at the back wall (01:53) with no visible path around the counter; at the same moment a second, semi-transparent waitress figure fades in at the rear by the pass-through window and persists (01:52-01:57). Motion is discontinuous and an entity appears without any entering action.
